description: This file defines the SUGAR.EmailAddressWidget class and related functions for managing email addresses within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM platform, including UI interactions, validation, and email address management.

classes.name: SUGAR.EmailAddressWidget
classes.description: Class for managing email address UI components and validation in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: prefillEmailAddresses
methods.description: Pre-fills email addresses in the widget from provided data.

methods.name: retrieveEmailAddress
methods.description: Retrieves email address data via AJAX and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keydown events for email input fields.

methods.name: addEmailAddress
methods.description: Adds a new email address input row to the widget.

methods.name: EmailAddressValidation
methods.description: Sets up validation for email addresses.

methods.name: removeEmailAddress
methods.description: Removes an email address input row from the widget.

methods.name: fixPrimaryRadioCheckboxValue
methods.description: Ensures primary email radio buttons are correctly set.
